topic: why Apple earns a much bigger margin on App Store and other services than on iPhones
storyAngle: The phone is the doorway; the services are where the margin lives.
doNotClaim: Do not state the App Store commission as a single number (it varies 15-30%).
These are Apple FY2024 gross margins, not profit per phone.

facts.claim: Apple FY2024 SERVICES gross margin percentage was 73.9% (70.8% the year before).
Apple FY2024 PRODUCTS gross margin percentage was 37.2%.
Apple FY2024 SERVICES gross margin was $71,050 million.
